high_level_description: The image is an infographic titled "The Evolution of Silicon Valley: Booms, Trends, and Icons." It is divided into three sections, each representing a different period in the history of Silicon Valley. 2000-2004: Dot Com Bust The section is labeled with a red banner and describes the period as the "Dot Com bust." The text explains that during this time, there was a survival of the fittest among startups, with weak companies vanishing and venture capitalists (VCs) pulling out.
